<entry id="U01954">
<head-word>שֵׂרָטוֹן</head-word>
<head-word>שֵׂי'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (שָׂרַט; cmp. סַרְטָן) [
<italic>scrapings,</italic>] 
<italic>sandbank, alluvial land</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 56
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 21
<sup>b</sup> בשעה … והעלה ש' ועליו וכ' when Solomon married Pharaoh’s daughter, Gabriel went down and stuck a reed into the sea, and it gathered a bank around it, on which the great city of Rome was built; Yalk. Kings 172; (Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39
<sup>c</sup> שלעטיט). Erub. 8
<sup>a</sup> ש' (הים) שמא יעלה (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes 5, a. 10) the sea (river) may throw up alluvium (may recede). Ber. 60
<sup>a</sup> (in Chald. dict.) אע"ג … דמסקא ארעא ש' (Ms. M. a. Ar. סרטון) although the loss of land through the encroachment of the water may be an advantage to him, because the land is covered with alluvium and improves, yet for the moment it is a misfortune to him. B. Bath. 124
<sup>a</sup> ארעא ואסקא ש' (not ואסיק) if his father left him a field, and it improved by alluvium; ib. 135
<sup>b</sup>. Tam. 30
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U01955">
<head-word>שִׁרְטֵט</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. שָׂרַט) 
<italic>to draw, rule, trace</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. VII, 10
<sup>c</sup> bot. מה עיבוד … שהיו מְשַׁרְטְטִין בעורות what working in leather was done at the preparation of the Tabernacle? They traced the outlines on the skins (marked out the shape in which they were to be cut, v. שִׁירְטוּט). Ib. top [read:] מה צביעה … שהיו משרטטין בעורות what painting was done at the preparation of the Tabernacle? They marked the skins (with a coloring substance); [the following אלים מאדמים ought to be preceded by עורות, as the catchword to the subsequent discussion, v. Tosef. ib. VIII, 23].—Part. pass. מְשׁוּרְטָט; f. מְשׁוּרְטֶטֶת. Men. 32
<sup>b</sup> מזוזה שאינה מש' a door post inscription which is not written on ruled parchment.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U01959">
<head-word>שרי</head-word>
<head-word>שָׁרָה</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083">root in מִשְׁרָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to dissolve, soak, steep</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Naz. VI, 1 ש' פתו ביין וכ' if he (the Nazirite) steeped his bread in wine, and there is enough in both together to make up the size of an olive; Pes. 44
<sup>b</sup>. Naz. 37
<sup>a</sup> אם ש' ענביו במים וכ' if he steeped grapes in water, and a taste of wine remained in it. Pes. II, 7 אין שׁוֹרִין וכ' you dare not soak bran for chickens (on the Passover); ib. האשה לא תִשְׁרֶה וכ' a woman must not soak bran to take with her to the bathhouse. Sabb. I, 5 אין שורין … כדי שיִשּׁוֹרוּ וכ' you must not lay in ink-materials or dyes …, unless they can be dissolved (or soaked through) before the Sabbath sets in. Eduy. I, 8; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִשְׁרָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be soaked, dissolved</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. IX, 13
<sup>d</sup> bot. כדי שתִּשָּׁרֶה וכ', v. מְגוּפָה; Y. Taan. I, 64
<sup>b</sup> top שתשרף (corr. acc.). Gen. R. s. 17, end אדם … מיד היא נִשְׁרֵית … אינו נִשְׁרֶה man is made out of earth, when you put a drop of water on it, it is at once dissolved (soft), but woman is made of a bone, which is not dissolved, even if you let it lie in water for many days. Y. Sabb. XIV, 14
<sup>c</sup> top כל … והיא נשרית … ושאינה נשרית וכ' when you put salt in, and it dissolves, it is called salt water, but when it is not dissolved, it is called 
<italic>halmé</italic>; a. e.—Sabb. I, 5 יִשּׁוֹרוּ (fr. שור or נשר), v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U01960">
<head-word>שרי</head-word>
<head-word>שָׁרָה</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> cmp. preced.) 
<italic>to loosen, untie;</italic> (cmp. meaning of καταλύω) 
<italic>to take lodging; to rest, dwell</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 11
<sup>a</sup> יש … שראוי שתִּשְׁרֶה עליו שכינה there is one among you who deserves that the Shechinah should rest upon him. Ib. 65
<sup>b</sup> כדי שתִּשְׁרֶה וכ', v. רָעֵב 
<italic>Hif.</italic> Ib. שׁוֹרָה עליו וכ' the spirit … comes down upon him. Y. Sabb. VIII, end, 11
<sup>c</sup> רוח רעה שורה עליה an evil spirit rests upon it (it is injurious to health). Num. R. s. 13
<sup>2</sup> אימתי שָׁרְתָה וכ' when did the Shechinah come down to rest on earth? When the Tabernacle was erected. Koh. R. to VII, 2 ושָׁרַת עליהם 
<pgbrk id="pg1630" /> וכ'the holy spirit rested upon them. Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVI ומלאכי … ושׁוֹרִים ביניהם (not ושוררים) the ministering angels rejoice over them (the righteous that die), that they come to dwell among them; ed. Bub. שהוא בא ושורה וכ' that he (the righteous man) comes &c.; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. שָׁרוּי; f. שְׁרוּיָה; 
<plural-form>pl. שְׁרוּיִין; שְׁרוּיוֹת</plural-form>. Yeb. 62
<sup>b</sup> he that has no wife, ש' בלא שמחה וכ' lives without joy, without blessing &c. Sot. 48
<sup>a</sup> בזמן שישראל ש' בצער וכ' when Israel lives in trouble, and the nations in peace and happiness &c. Meg. 2
<sup>a</sup> בזמן שהשנים … ש' על אדמתן when the years were properly regulated (without Roman interference), and the Israelites lived (undisturbed) on their soil; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁרָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to rest</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 139
<sup>a</sup> אין הקב"ה מַשְׁרֶה וכ' the Lord does not let his Presence rest upon Israel, until the bad judges and officers cease to exist. Snh. 7
<sup>a</sup> כל דיין … משרה a judge that administers true justice faithfully, causes the Shechinah to dwell in Israel. Gen. R. s. 7 מלך … ומשרה דיורין וכ' a human king builds a palace, and lets the inmates dwell in the upper and lower stories, הק"בה משרה … בחלל the Lord makes inmates dwell (even) in vacant space. Num. R. s. 13
<sup>6</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. שֵׁירוּתָא) 
<italic>to board, provide a living for</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. V, 8 המשרה את אשתו וכ', v. שָׁלִישׁ. Ib. 107
<sup>a</sup> כשה' לזו ולא ה' לזו when he provided for the one (his wife), but did not provide for the others (his children); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U01961">
<head-word>שְׁרֵי</head-word>
<head-word>שְׁרָא</head-word>
<head-word>שְׁרֵא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to untie, unharness; to disengage, dismiss</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XXIV, 32 וש' גמליא (ed. Berl. וש' מן ג'; Y. ושָׁ' זממי ג' 
<italic>Pa.</italic>; h. text ויפתח). Targ. Job XXX, 11. Targ. O. Ex. III, 5 (h. text של); a. fr.—Pes. 113
<sup>a</sup> שְׁרִי כיסך פתח שפיך untie thy purse (to receive the money), open thy bag (to deliver the goods), i.e. sell for cash. Snh. 98
<sup>a</sup> כולהון שְׁרוֹ ואסירי … איהו ש' חד וכ' all of them untie and tie up (their sores) at once (untie all of them, and then tie them up), but he unties and ties up one at a time. Pesik. R. s. 22 [read:] שַׁרְתַּנְהוֹן … ע"ג סודרא she untied them (the two Denars), and placed them on the shawl. Y. Ber. II, 5
<sup>a</sup> bot. אתת … ושַׁרְתוּן וכ' (fr. שרה, cmp. חֲמֵי) when prayer time came, he untied them (the coins), and gave them to R. H.; [read:] קטר פורתיה לפורתיה ויהבון לשמעיה ושרתון וערק he tied his (R. Ḥ’s) share to his own, and gave them to his servant, but he (the servant) untied them and ran away. Y. Meg. IV, 75
<sup>b</sup> bot. שְׁרוֹן ליה וכ', v. סַפְרוּתָא. Y. Keth. XII, 35
<sup>a</sup> שרון גרמון ומנוניה they dismissed themselves (resigned their office) and appointed him (Hillel) in their place; a. fr.—ש' תיגרא to solve a dispute, 
<italic>to settle</italic> or 
<italic>decide</italic> a case. Ned. 62
<sup>a</sup> שְׁרוּ לי תיגראי ברישא take my case up first. Yeb. 100
<sup>a</sup> שָׁרֵינָא וכ', v. תִּגְרָא I; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to allow, permit; to forgive; to absolve</italic> (= h. הִתִּיר).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Num. XXX, 3. Targ. Y. II Gen. XXII, 14. Targ. Y. II Num. XIV, 20; a. fr.—Kidd. 13
<sup>b</sup> הוא אסרה והוא שַׁרְתָהּ (Rashi שרי לה) he tied her (by marrying her), and he untied her (through his death, that she can dispose of herself). Y. Ber. II, 5
<sup>b</sup> אינון שַׁרְיָין ואינון אסרין do the same men permit and forbid? Y. Snh. VII, end, 25
<sup>d</sup> [read:] שַׁרְיִי מה דעבדתין אמרה ליה לי נא שַׁרְיָיה undo what thou hast done (by charm); said she to him, I will not undo. Bab. ib. 99
<sup>a</sup> ש' ליה מריה וכ' the Lord forgive R. Hillel. Ab. Zar. 37
<sup>a</sup> וקרו לן בית דינא שָׁרְיָא and they might call us a permitting court (of lax practice). Ib. כי שְׁרִיתוּהָ לאלתר שריתוה וכ' when you permitted her (to marry again), did you permit her to marry at once &c.? Ib. וקרו ליה יוסף שריא and they called him Joseph the permitter. Ib. אנא נמי שְׁרָאִי אחריתי Ms. M. (ed. אנא שרא, corr. acc.) I also permitted another thing (which was forbidden heretofore); a. v. fr.—Part. pass. שָׁרֵי, שַׁרְיָא; f. שַׁרְיָא. Targ. II Esth. III, 8 יומא ש' a permitted day (free for trade).—Bets. 3
<sup>b</sup> לדידי אפי' … ש' according to my opinion it is permitted even on the first day. Ib. 22
<sup>a</sup> אפי' בשבת ש' it is permitted even on the Sabbath. Ned. 62
<sup>a</sup> ש' ליה לאינש לאודועי וכ' a man is permitted to make himself known (as a scholar) in a place where they do not know him; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>to loosen the girdle,</italic>] 
<italic>to sit down for a meal</italic>; trnsf. 
<italic>to start, begin</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Deut. XVI, 9 (O. ed. Berl. תְּשָׁרֵי, 
<italic>Pa.</italic>). Targ. II Esth. III, 7; a. fr.—Lam. R. to I, 1 (רבתי) כמה דשְׁרִין למיכל (ed. Wil. דשְׁרוֹ) when they sat down to eat. Y. Dem. I, 21
<sup>d</sup> bot.; Y. Shek. V, 48
<sup>d</sup> top שַׁרְיַית מנהקה (not שוריית) she began to bray; a. fr.—Trnsf. (cmp. meanings of b. h. יָאַל Hif.) 
<italic>to consent, be willing</italic>. Targ. Josh. VII, 7. Ib. XVII, 12. Targ. Job VI, 9; 28; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to encamp, dwell, rest</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. I Sam. XXVI, 5. Targ. Num. II, 2, sq. Targ. Ex. XL, 35. Targ. Ps. XVI, 8, sq.; a. fr.—Y. Ter. VIII, 46
<sup>a</sup> חמריא שרון וכ' ass-drivers took lodging in an inn. Lam. R. to I, 1 רבתי אשכח … שרון יתבין וכ' (חד מירוש') he found men that had taken lodging there, and sat eating and drinking. Y. Sabb. XIV, 14
<sup>c</sup> bot. ע"י דהוה ש' תמן וכ' because he lived there (in Babylonia) &c. Gen. R. s. 20 ויתיר … שרי, v. פָּרָא II. Snh. 39
<sup>a</sup> כל בי … שָׁרְיָא the Shechinah dwells wherever ten persons are assembled; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>שָׁרֵי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to untie, loosen</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. XXX, 12 (ed. Wil. 
<italic>Pe.</italic>). Targ. Job XII, 18 (ed. Wil. מַשְׁרֵי 
<italic>Af.</italic>); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to begin</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Deut. I, 5 (Y. שׁוֹרֵי 
<italic>Poel</italic>). Ib. II, 24 (O. ed. Vien. Pe.). Ib. 25. Targ. Jer. IV, 31; a. fr.—Targ. Prov. XIII, 12 דמְשָׁרֵי למעדריה (not משדי, v. Pesh. a. LXX) who begins to help himself (h. text תחלת ממשכה!).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to rest</italic>, v. infra.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַשְׁרֵי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to untie</italic>, v. supra.</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to encamp</italic> or 
<italic>dwell, to let rest</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. II, 15. Targ. Jer. VII, 7. Targ. Ps. XXIII, 2. Ib. LXXIV, 2 Ms. (ed. 
<italic>Pa.</italic>); a. fr.—Sabb. 67
<sup>a</sup> הסנה … א' קודשא וכ' O thornbush! not because thou art higher than all other trees did the Lord let his Presence rest upon thee &c. Koh. R. to III, 9, end כל … לא מַשְׁרִין וכ' (in the hereafter) they allow every one to dwell only with his fellow tradesmen; ib. beg. מתרין (corr. acc.); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִשְׁתָּרֵי, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִישְׁתְּרֵי, אִישְּׁרֵי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be untied, loosened</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Is. V, 27.—Lev. R. s. 14, v. חֲבִילָא II; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be permitted</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 106
<sup>a</sup> כי היכי דתִישְׁתְּרִי לעלמא in order that she may be free to marry again. Bets. 2
<sup>b</sup> יו"ט בעלמא תשתרי let it be permitted for use on any other Holy Day (not followed by the Sabbath); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be begun, begin</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVII, 17. Targ. Ps. CXIX, 96, v. שַׁכְלֵל.—Y. Ter. VIII, 46
<sup>a</sup> מישרי נבח בהון (prob. to be read: אישרי) he began to bark at them; ib. מישרי מתרתר, v. תַּרְתֵּר.—[Lev. R. s. 13 אשתריתין, v. שְׁתַר.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<italic>Saf</italic>.</definition>

<sup>b</sup> (play on בגדי השרד, Ex. XXXV, 19) אלמלא … ש' ופליט but for the garments of priesthood, there would not be left of Israel a remnant or a survivor. Ḥull. 133

<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (שָׂרַף I) 
<italic>acrid substance</italic>, esp. 
<italic>vegetable sap made thick by inspissation; resin, gum</italic> (secreted by the heat of the sun).</definition>
<notes> Ber. 44
<sup>a</sup> כל סעודה שאין בה ש' וכ' Ms. M. (ed. שָׂרִיף) a meal without an acrid substance (bitter herbs &c.) is no meal. Pes. 39
<sup>a</sup>, v. מַר II. Tosef. ib. I (II), 33 כל שיש בו ש' וכ' any plant which contains an acrid sap is fit to be used on the Passover night. Orl. I, 7 שְׂרַף העלים the sap of leaves; ש' העקרים of roots; ש' הפגים of unripe grapes. Y. ib. I, 61
<sup>b</sup> bot. למה ש' פרי פגין פרי why (this difference in the law between resin and juice of unripe fruits)? resin is fruit and grapes are fruit. Ib. קטף בטל ע"י שִׂרְפּוֹ resin ceases to exist when its sap is pressed out; Y. Shebi. VII, end, 37
<sup>c</sup>. Ib. אילן אינו בטל ע"ג שרפו the tree does not cease to exist when its sap is tapped. Ker. 6
<sup>a</sup>; Sabb. 26
<sup>a</sup> צרי אינו אלא ש' וכ' balsam is only a gum that drips from the balsam tree. Y. ib. II, 4
<sup>d</sup> אין … מפני שהוא ש' you must not use balsam for the Sabbath light, because it is a gum. Gen. R. s. 94, v. סָפַג; Tanḥ. B’midbar 16 השבט (corr. acc.); a. e.—Trnsf. 
<italic>secretion, matter</italic>. Nidd. 10
<sup>b</sup> זו שִׂירְפָּה מצוי וכ' with the one (the newly married virgin) secretion (from a wound caused by first coition) is frequent &c.; [oth. opin.: with the wife of older standing secretion is frequent].—
<plural-form>Pl. שְׂרָפִים, שְׂרָפִין</plural-form>. Sabb. 23
<sup>a</sup> כל הש' יפין וכ' all gums are good for ink, but the gum of the balsam tree is the best.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="V00000">
<head-word>ת</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Tav, the twenty-second letter of the alphabet.—It interchanges with ט, q. v.; dialectically with ש, e.g. שׁוּב, Chald. תּוּב; שָׁבַר, Chald. תְּבַר.—ת a preformative letter for verbal nouns, e.g. תַּבְשִׁיל, fr. בָּשַׁל; תְּרוּמָה, fr. רוּם; an afformative letter, e.g. תַּרְעוֹמֶת, fr. רָעַם. Secondary verbs are formed from such nouns, e.g. תָּרַם, fr. תְּרוּמָה; הִתְחִיל, fr. תְּחִלָּה; or from verbs, e.g. תָּאַב, fr. אָבָה.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
